name: Larb with pork
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai larb moo (4 small servings: 1 cup ground pork, 2 tbsp shallot, 1/4 cup each of mint and cilantro, 1 tbsp each of fish sauce, lime juice and toasted rice powder) and Eating Thai Food's larb moo. Per plate 100 g of cooked mince; toasted rice powder is counted as dry rice, chilli flakes and spring onion are left out as under 3 g.
